data.action: 盘腿坐在客厅地毯上，双手操作游戏手柄
data.description: 【御坂美琴 · 客厅游戏】宿舍客厅松软的地毯上，美琴盘腿坐着，双手飞快地按动着游戏手柄上的每一个按键，屏幕上的格斗角色正打出一连串华丽连招。她兴奋地冲身旁的你大喊——「看招看招！这一套超必杀技你绝对防不住！今晚输掉游戏的人要负责去买明天的早餐便当！」
data.promptProse: Misaka Mikoto sits cross-legged on the dorm living-room rug with a controller in both hands, thumbs working rapidly through a fighting-game combination. Casual shirt and jeans retain the indoor outfit. The medium view connects her focused face and controller to the screen at the room's far side. Warm table-lamp light reveals rug texture and her nearer sleeve, while shifting display colors illuminate the gripping fingers and cast cooler shade behind her.
